items.title: 6.3 Applications and Implications of Cloud Computing

blocks.text: Cloud computing has changed how businesses and individuals manage, process and store data. Its applications span many sectors with scalable, cost-effective solutions, from hosting websites and running applications to data storage and collaboration, helping organizations cut IT costs and respond quickly to change. It also brings implications that must be managed.

blocks.prompt: Name three applications and two implications of cloud computing.
blocks.explanation: Applications: data storage, web hosting and content delivery, machine learning and AI. Implications: data security and cost management (also scalability management and compliance).

items: Cloud: wide applications, plus implications for security, resources, cost and compliance.
